summary: Tested Designer Engineering (DE) giver application (GST + Testimonials) end-to-end, privacy of new fields in public directory, admin confidential GST/Testimonials columns, and Admin Follow-Ups tab. Backend 15/15 pytest pass. Frontend: DE block shows via profile type AND via offering chip, hidden for non-DE givers; step-3 Continue blocked with correct toasts (missing/invalid GST, no complete testimonial); add up to 5 / remove when >1 works; GST auto-uppercased; full UI registration succeeded and stored gst + only complete testimonials. Confidential page shows GST + testimonials. Follow-Ups: filters, toggle, note save and persistence work individually, BUT one race bug found (typing a note then directly clicking the toggle loses the toggle). Only 3 real registrations performed (2 via API due to pytest-xdist running module fixture per worker, 1 via UI); all TEST_ users + sessions deleted afterwards.

minor.issue: Documented credential DentalHub@2026 returns 401 for vsv.visakhapatnam@gmail.com: user doc has password_changed=true (password reset via /auth/reset-password at some point), so seed no longer restores it. Other 2 staff accounts work. Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md or reset if unintended.
Testimonial fields have pydantic max_length (120/120/1000) but frontend inputs have no maxLength -> long input yields a 422 with generic validation message. Add maxLength on inputs.

ui_bugs.issue: Race: when admin types a note and then directly clicks the 'Not contacted' toggle, the input onBlur fires save(contacted=false) and the click fires save(true) concurrently; the blur request wins and the row stays 'Not contacted' (reproduced; DB showed contacted:false with the new note). Fix: in toggle onClick use onMouseDown preventDefault / skip blur-save when relatedTarget is the toggle, or serialize saves / send latest state.

issues: GST Number and Testimonials columns are at the far right and cut off at 1920px; requires horizontal scroll - consider moving them earlier or making table wider/wrapping

rca of the issue: Follow-up race: FollowUpRow note Input has onBlur={() => note changed && save(contacted)}; clicking the toggle button blurs the input first, launching PUT {contacted:false}, then onClick launches PUT {contacted:true}. Both 200; final DB state depends on server processing order and UI onSaved order -> observed contacted:false. Mitigation: onMouseDown={e=>e.preventDefault()} on toggle, or check e.relatedTarget in onBlur, or a single in-flight queue.
